# Cognitive Model Templates Index

Every template in `docs/templates/`, grouped by what it documents. Field
templates are the `<type>_template.md` files that `cognitive-create-node
--type <type>` renders; copy-and-edit templates are copied by hand. See
[[docs/templates/template_guide|the template guide]] for both workflows.

## Model components (field templates)

- [[docs/templates/agent_template|Agent template]]: a cognitive agent with its
  beliefs, goals, actions and observations.
- [[docs/templates/belief_template|Belief template]]: a belief, its prior
  distribution, dependencies and update dynamics.
- [[docs/templates/action_template|Action template]]: an action with its
  parameters, preconditions, execution and effects.
- [[docs/templates/goal_template|Goal template]]: a goal with its parameters,
  planning, motivation and evaluation.
- [[docs/templates/observation_template|Observation template]]: an observation
  with its data structure, processing and belief integration.
- [[docs/templates/environment_template|Environment template]]: an environment
  with its state space, action space, dynamics and scenarios.
- [[docs/templates/memory_system_template|Memory system template]]: a memory
  system with its structure, operations, dynamics and representation.
- [[docs/templates/reasoning_system_template|Reasoning system template]]: a
  reasoning system with its paradigm, mechanisms, decision making and
  evaluation.
- [[docs/templates/cognitive_architecture_template|Cognitive architecture template]]:
  an architecture composed of agents, belief systems, memory and learning.

## Experiments and analysis (field templates)

- [[docs/templates/experiment_template|Experiment template]]: objectives,
  design, data collection, analysis and results.
- [[docs/templates/analysis_template|Analysis template]]: data processing,
  statistical methods, visualization and interpretation.

## Concepts, research and implementation (copy-and-edit)

- [[docs/templates/ai_concept_template|AI concept template]]: an AI or
  cognitive-modeling concept (overview, theory, implementation, validation).
- [[docs/templates/cognitive_concept|Cognitive concept template]]: a cognitive
  science concept (foundations, evidence, limitations).
- [[docs/templates/research_document|Research document template]]: research
  question, methodology, results and discussion.
- [[docs/templates/implementation_example|Implementation example template]]: a
  worked implementation, with a dispatcher example that runs against the
  `cognitive` package.
- [[docs/templates/package_component|Package component template]]: a software
  component page (installation, usage, API, tests).

## Guides, learning and linking (copy-and-edit)

- [[docs/templates/guide_template|Guide template]]: step-by-step instructional
  guides.
- [[docs/templates/learning_path_template|Learning path template]]: structured
  learning paths with prerequisites, phases and assessment.
- [[docs/templates/linking_template|Linking template]]: link sections,
  relationship types and link annotations.
